definitions.explanation: A formal ceremony to celebrate the completion of studies at a school.

examples.japanese: {卒業式|そつぎょうしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}した→流す：01968_nagasu⟧。
examples.english: I shed tears at the graduation ceremony.

examples.japanese: {卒業式|そつぎょうしき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧3⟦{月|がつ}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The graduation ceremony is held in March.

examples.japanese: {卒業式|そつぎょうしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{校長|こうちょう}→校長：01582_kouchou⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The principal gave a speech at the graduation ceremony.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧ (graduation) + ⟦{式|しき}→〜式：02000_shiki⟧ (ceremony). One of the most emotionally significant events in Japanese school life.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Typically held in March. Formal events featuring the school song, individual diploma presentations, and often tearful farewells. Students wear their uniforms; at some schools, the second button (⟦{第二|だいに}→第〜：03960_dai⟧⟦ボタン→ボタン：02963_botan⟧) is given as a memento.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {卒業式|そつぎょうしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}→出席：02084_shusseki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to attend a graduation ceremony
- {卒業式|そつぎょうしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{泣|な}く→泣く：00655_naku⟧: to cry at graduation
- ⟦{卒業証書|そつぎょうしょうしょ}→卒業証書：28982_sotsugyoushousho⟧: diploma
- ⟦{卒業証書授与|そつぎょうしょうしょじゅよ}→卒業証書授与：noentry⟧: diploma presentation

RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{入学式|にゅうがくしき}→入学式：05495_nyuugakushiki⟧: entrance ceremony (held in April)
- ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧: graduation
